newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kian Ann plans convertible share issue.
newsitem.headline: Kian Ann plans convertible share issue.

text.p: Kian Ann Engineering Ltd plans to raise approximately Singapore $11.4 million through an issue of redeemable convertible cumulative preference shares, arranger and manager DBS Bank said on Wednesday.
DBS said in a statement the issue would structured as a bought deal with DBS and the shares would be placed with financial institutions and other investors.
The proceeds of the issue would be used partly to finance the construction of a new warehouse cum office building in Changi South, Singapore, it said.
In-principle approval for the listing of the new shares had been obtained from the Stock Exchange of Singapore but the issue was still subject to approval by the company's shareholders.
